title: オグリの大食い選手権

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An eating contest is being held at the academy. I spot Oguri Cap among the contestants.
choice_data_list: Hold on, Oguri! You're going to gain weight again!
Hold on, Oguri! You're going to gain weight again!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Don't get in my way! Now's not the time! I have to win this contest.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The winner gets a coupon for a supersize bowl of ramen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has her mind set on this. There's only thing I can say…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has her mind set on this. There's only thing I can say…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Thanks. You just sit right back and watch.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do whatever it takes to win that supersize ramen coupon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She speaks with bold, unwavering conviction. Seeing her like this reminds me of when she's racing.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap wins! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes, I did it! The prize is mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap's smile is even brighter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Would you believe it? We have two winners—Oguri Cap and Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Argh, I tied with Special Week. I hope we both still get the prize…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap seems a little frustrated, but before I can console her, I need to come up with some healthy meal options to offset this major disruption to her usual diet.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But this is an eating contest. You have to overdo it if you want a chance at winning.
choice_data_list: I can buy you some ramen if you want it that badly.
I can buy you some ramen if you want it that badly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Fine… I'll do what I can.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: And the winner is Special Week! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I lost… But I guess it doesn't matter. You're treating me to some ramen anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap fixes me with a resolute stare. I make a mental note to find a place that serves healthy ramen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mm… You mean I shouldn't leave even a spot of sauce behind?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, I'm sure that would please the people who made the food too. I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: For the next round, our contestants have to devour a pile of fried chicken the size of Mount Fuji! I expect that even the most confident gluttons will be calling it quits!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: It's no good! I can't fit in even one more bite!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I'll finish it for you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What? B-but why?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Phew… Not a crumb left. What a meal!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: We have a winner! Oguri Cap—who, for some reason, even volunteered to eat another competitor's food! She's on a whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Completely unrivaled, Oguri Cap has redefined what it means to win an eating contest… at the cost of a substantial caloric intake.
